div.p: Certify Studio is a professional online certificate generator created for colleges, educational institutions, workshops, seminars, internships, training programs, and academic events.

The platform enables educators, coordinators, and organizations to create elegant, print-ready certificates directly from the browser without requiring advanced design software or technical expertise.

Certify Studio focuses on simplicity, professional design quality, and fast certificate generation. Users can customize certificate titles, recipient names, institutional branding, signatures, seals, and export certificates in high-resolution PNG or PDF formats suitable for digital sharing and professional printing.
Key features include:

ul.li: Browser-based processing with no software installation

div.p: The platform is designed to support educational and institutional workflows while maintaining a clean, accessible, and efficient user experience.
At Certify Studio, user privacy and data security are important priorities.

Certify Studio operates primarily as a browser-based certificate generation tool. Certificate customization, image uploads, and rendering processes occur locally within the user's browser environment.
We do not intentionally collect, store, or process personally sensitive certificate information submitted through the generator interface.
